title: Configure, Query, and Troubleshoot Summary Indexing Through CLI/Configuration
objectives: Configure, Query, and Troubleshoot Summary Indexing Through CLI/Configuration
Verify result values and the persisted operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture has three explicit source_logs events and starts with the clock paused. Keep it paused while configuring, then use clock controls or the Interview Workbench advance action for scheduled work.
The fixture schedules Configuration summary into a missing destination. Advance one minute, then inspect the failed run; no summary events should have been manufactured.

Create source_stats with retention=2592000. In sh01 savedsearches.conf repair action.summary_index._name=source_stats and keep enableSched=1, cron_schedule=* * * * *, dispatch.earliest_time=-1m@m and dispatch.latest_time=@m. Reload or restart.

Append a fresh copy of the three fixture records to /var/log/practice/reports.log on idx01. Advance across the next minute boundary. Inspect actual run provenance and verify a summary total of three for that new window.

hints: Inspect the source results and time window before saving or scheduling a report.
Use savedsearches.conf or simulated REST to independently verify the definition; inspect actual execution history and search the summary destination.
